name: transformation-morph
intent: Profile A collapses into an ink intermediate silhouette, then expands into Profile B with a visible inherited trait mark.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Profile B shown immediately with inherited trait mark; no collapse/ink/expand

acceptance: Sequence is collapse (140ms) → ink intermediate hold (120ms) → expand Profile B (150ms)
Cards/silhouette use scale+visibility (not opacity fade as primary); ink uses clipped polygon silhouette
Resolved Profile B shows inherited trait mark FROM SCOUT
Replay resets to Profile A Scout before rerunning
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows Profile B immediately
